mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO friends (owner_account_id, friend_account_id, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerAccountId}, #{friendAccountId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id, a.account, a.nickname, a.password_hash, a.avatar_version, a.role, a.permit, a.stealth, a.status, a.deleted_at, a.created_at, a.created_ip, a.last_login_at, a.last_login_ip, a.e2ee_salt, a.identity_pub_key FROM friends f JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = f.friend_account_id WHERE f.owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.nickname COLLATE NOCASE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_requests (id, from_account_id, to_account_id, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fromAccountId}, #{toAccountId}, 'PENDING', #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, from_account_id, to_account_id, status, created_at, handled_at FROM friend_requests WHERE to_account_id = #{toAccountId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
